scientific_integrity: Original model and its unconditioned stationary formulas credited; derived conditional far-field composition and its unique reset-rate optimum proved analytically, supported by separate symbolic and numerical checks.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional symmetric Markov switching with strictly positive rates, full Poisson resetting to the origin, and either diffusive or equiprobable ballistic phase preparation only. No claims for partial resets, biased headings, first-passage optimization, or independence from every possible reset law; uniqueness is for the physical branch. Independent priority assessment not performed.
title: Protocol-independent extreme-direction bias and its unique reset-rate optimum in intermittent transport
